content: The function StbM_<bus>SetSlaveTimingData() shall be pre compile time configurable ON / OFF. If the corresponding <bus>TSyn module is configured with Tim e Validation Support enabled (refer to parameter <bus>TSynTimeValidationSupport in <bus>TSyn module) StbM_ <bus> SetSlaveTimingData() shall be ON , otherwise OFF .
